'''Morol''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked in [[Just Armor]], a store carrying a variety of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and personal armor, located on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[StarForge Station]]<ref name="Orbit" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> While Morol took care of armor repair and fitting, [[Gjaddia]], another Human, was the businessman.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Morol first appeared in ''[[Preparing for War]]'', an adventure scenario from the [[1998]] book ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Orbit" />
